name: Celes Alford
original_name: セリス・アルフォード
source:
A half-blooded girl who transfers in. She’s also a tsundere girl, and a sheltered ojou-sama to boot. Her natural prettiness overcomes [url=/c1570]Madoka[/url] and so she’s often being hugged to death. Her main feature, is that she finds bad puns hilarious, and will constantly try to make new ones up. The worse the pun, the louder she’ll laugh.

Celes is in some way similar to Atsushi in middle school as they tried to close their heart as they always have to transfer schools.

[spoiler] In Celes Route, Her father allowed her to stay as what her father wants for her is her happiness and as long as she doesn't regret it and has found her happiness, he is fine with her staying. In the end, she goes to England with her dad but returns a year later. She promises to return. [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.neechin.net/article/48/natsumegu-nonspoiler]Agilis's review[/url].]
